subject: Logic
title: Nested Quantifiers
description: A quick, practical guide to Nested Quantifiers.

hook.text: "Everyone loves someone" and "someone is loved by everyone" use the same words—but mean different things.

buildup.text: ∀x ∃y L(x,y): for every person, there's someone they love. Each person can love a different someone.

discovery.text: ∃y ∀x L(x,y): there's one person everyone loves. A single beloved individual.

twist.text: Order matters! Swapping ∀ and ∃ changes meaning completely. This catches even experienced logicians.

climax.text: Read nested quantifiers from left to right. The outer one sets the scope for the inner one.

punchline.text: Same words, swap order, new meaning.

quiz.question: Does swapping ∀ and ∃ change the meaning?
options: Yes, it can completely change the meaning
